# Property

Real estate. Supports individual ownership, communal/family property (Nigeria), HUF coparcenary (India), government-vested land (Land Use Act), US community property, and informal/unregistered holdings

Source: [`v3/property.json`](../../v3/property.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/property.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this property within the INHERIT document |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Display name for this property — a familiar label or street address. Should be recognisable to all parties involved in the estate |
| `propertyType` | one of `detached`, `attached`, `apartment`, `land`, `commercial`, `mixed_use`, `rural`, `mobile`, `watercraft`, `other` | | Territory-neutral property type. Use reference-data/local-term-mappings.json to display jurisdiction-appropriate labels in UIs |
| `address` | [PostalAddress](common/address.md) | | Physical address of the property |
| `estimatedValue` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Owner's estimate of the property's current market value, in minor currency units |
| `professionalValuation` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Professional surveyor or valuer's assessment of the property value, in minor currency units |
| `netEquity` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Value of this property net of the active charges secured against it, in minor currency units. A convenience denormalisation: the authoritative figure is derived, not stored |
| `inNegativeEquity` | `boolean` | | True when the active charges secured against this property exceed its value. Set alongside a netEquity of zero, because the zero floor would otherwise hide the shortfall |
| `valuationDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the most recent valuation (estimated or professional) was performed |
| `valuationConfidence` | one of `estimated`, `professional`, `official`, `unknown` | | Level of confidence in the stated valuation |
| `isPrimaryResidence` | `boolean` | | Whether this is the testator's primary residence. Relevant for residence nil rate band (UK), homestead exemption (US), and similar tax reliefs |
| `ownershipType` | one of `sole`, `joint_tenants`, `tenants_in_common`, `trust`, `tenancy_by_entirety` | | How ownership of this property is legally structured |
| `ownershipPercentage` | `number` | | The testator's ownership share as a percentage. For joint tenants, typically 50% for two co-owners. For tenants in common, may be any split |
| `ownershipModel` | one of `individual`, `joint`, `communal_family`, `huf_coparcenary`, `tribal`, `government_vested`, `trust_held` | | The cultural or legal model of ownership. Goes beyond the simple legal title to capture communal and customary ownership forms |
| `acquisitionType` | one of `self_acquired`, `ancestral_joint`, `ancestral_severed`, `inherited`, `gifted`, `stridhan`, `communal`, `waqf_endowed` | | How the property was acquired. Determines which succession law applies in India and other jurisdictions |
| `tenureType` | one of `ownership`, `lease`, `communal`, `customary`, `informal`, `government_allocated` | | Territory-neutral tenure type. Use reference-data/local-term-mappings.json to display jurisdiction-appropriate labels in UIs |
| `registrationStatus` | one of `formally_registered`, `informally_held`, `community_acknowledged`, `disputed`, `undocumented` | | Whether this property is formally registered with a land authority |
| `ownershipEvidence` | one of `title_deed`, `certificate_of_occupancy`, `family_recognition`, `community_testimony`, `receipts_only`, `none` | | The type of evidence available to prove ownership. In many jurisdictions, informal evidence is the only kind available |
| `culturalDisposition` | [Cultural Disposition](common/cultural-disposition.md) | | Cultural, religious, and regulatory constraints on disposal of this property |
| `communalAuthority` | `object` | | The communal or family authority whose approval is required to dispose of this property |
| `successionRegime` | `object` | | The succession regime governing this specific property. Overrides estate.defaultSuccessionRegime when present |
| `custodianPersonId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id of the current custodian of communal or family property. The custodian manages but does not own the property |
| `custodianPersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced custodian person |
| `governmentConsentRequired` | `boolean` | | Whether government or regulatory consent is required to transfer this property. Common in Nigeria (governor's consent) and for agricultural land in parts of India |
| `mobilityType` | one of `immoveable`, `moveable`, `mixed` | | Whether this property is classified as immoveable, moveable, or mixed. Determines which conflict-of-laws rules apply |
| `mortgageOutstanding` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Outstanding mortgage balance in minor currency units. If the property is mortgage-free, omit this field |
| `characterClassification` | one of `community`, `separate`, `quasi_community`, `mixed`, `not_applicable` | | Marital property character classification for US community property states. Determines whether the testator may dispose of the entire property or only their half |
| `homesteadStatus` | `object` | | US homestead exemption status. Protects the primary residence from creditors and may restrict the testator's ability to devise the property |
| `passesOutsideEstate` | `boolean` | | Whether this property passes outside the probate estate — typically via joint tenancy with right of survivorship, a transfer-on-death deed, or a trust |
| `statutoryLifeEstate` | `object` | | A life estate imposed by statute rather than by the will. The surviving spouse or other protected person has a right to occupy for life |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this property. Use for unusual tenure arrangements, ongoing disputes, or planning considerations |
| `externalLinks` | array of `object` | | Links to this property in external databases, portals, and registries — Land Registry, Rightmove, Zoopla, Zillow, council tax records, EPC certificates, etc |
| `images` | array of [Media](common/media.md) | | Photographs and videos of this property — exterior, interior, key rooms, any damage or features relevant to valuation |
| `visibility` | [Visibility](common/visibility.md) | | Controls who can see this property record |
| `fieldProvenance` | array of [FieldProvenance](common/field-provenance.md) | | Per-field provenance records — how each field's value was obtained |
| `comments` | array of `object` | | Discussion comments on this entity |
| `rentalIncome` | `object` | | Rental income details if the property is let — important for estate income tax and beneficiary entitlements |
| `epc` | `object` | | Energy Performance Certificate data. UK properties require an EPC for sale or letting. Rating A (most efficient) to G (least efficient). Legally significant — EPC below E cannot be let without exemption |
| `landRegistry` | `object` | | HM Land Registry data — title information, last sale price, and registered charges. Confirms ownership and surfaces encumbrances relevant to estate administration |
| `floodRisk` | `object` | | Flood risk data from the Environment Agency (England) or equivalent national agency. Affects insurability, value, and estate planning decisions |
| `leasehold` | `object` | | Leasehold-specific data — lease term, ground rent, service charge, freeholder. Relevant when tenureType is 'lease'. No conditional enforcement — allowed on any property for flexibility |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
| `applicableLaw` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | The jurisdiction whose succession law governs this item. Missing means defaults to estate domicile |
| `taxTreatment` | `object` | | Per-property tax treatment — how this property is classified for tax purposes |
| `taxReliefEligibility` | `object` | | Tax relief eligibility for this asset or property (e.g. Agricultural Property Relief, Business Property Relief) |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
